description: This Java class defines a KafkaPublishTarget that encapsulates a Kafka message target, including topic, key, and partition information. It provides methods to parse target addresses and validate Kafka-specific parameters.

classes.name: KafkaPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing a Kafka message target with topic, optional key, and optional partition.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget instance from a target address string by parsing key or partition indicators.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the target address contains a key separator.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithKey
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget from an address with a specified key.

methods.name: validateKey
methods.description: Validates and returns the key, or null if empty.

methods.name: containsPartition
methods.description: Checks if the target address contains a partition separator.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithPartition
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget from an address with a specified partition.

methods.name: validatePartition
methods.description: Validates and returns a partition number, or null if empty.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithOnlyTopic
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget with only a topic.

methods.name: validateTopic
methods.description: Validates the Kafka topic name using Kafka's validation method.

methods.name: parsePartitionOrThrow
methods.description: Parses a string into an Integer partition number or throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the key if present.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the partition if present.
